verdict.rationale: Virtualization and container support is a fair question for a laptop CPU, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions hardware virtualization, hypervisors (Hyper-V, WSL2, VMware, Parallels) or Docker on this silicon. The developer portal only covers Arm-native Windows toolchains and AI SDKs, which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
